content:
Anya (AM): Heads up 00 CT: NexusEdge partner ask: reseller margin approval discussion — partner requests 11% reseller margin and a 20% customer discount for a co-sell package. Commit: $250k ARR, 2-year term. They want MDF of $20k and a 1.5% additional rebate if ARR target exceeded.

Ravi (Partner Ops): NexusEdge is a top-tier channel partner in EMEA. They want 11% to fund certification trainers. We usually cap margin at 10% for tier-1 but exceptions possible with CFO ok. They also requested ability to resell under their brand (co-branding) which legal flagged last time.

Nate (Deal Desk): Quick checklist:
- Discount request: 20% off list
- Reseller margin: 11% (exception)
- MDF: $20k (one-time)
- Performance rebate: 1.5% if ARR > 300k in year 1
- Term: 24 months
We need Finance impact and Legal on co-branding + reseller terms. Also note: 2-year term changes recognition; need RevRec ops heads-in-loop.

Priya (Finance): Running a quick sensitivity:
```
ARR_commit = 250000
discount = 0.20
reseller_margin = 0.11
MDF = 20000
estimated_first_year_net = ARR_commit * (1 - discount) - MDF - (ARR_commit * reseller_margin)
```
Estimated_first_year_net = $250k * 0.8 - 20k - 27.5k = $132.5k (before costs)
We need to check CAC payback and compare to typical partner-sourced deals.

legal-bot: Flag: co-branding, reseller white-labeling, and MDF usage controls need standard clauses. Requesting contract draft with redlines.

Anya (AM): Partner says they won't sign unless they can claim co-branded collateral and 11% margin. They estimate closing 5 logos (avg ACV 50k) in Year 1 if approved.

Ravi (Partner Ops): Proposed compromise from partner ops:
- Approve 10% margin (cap) + $15k MDF
- 18% customer discount
- Co-branding allowed for joint assets only (no white-labeling)
- Performance kicker: additional 1% margin if partner hits 120% of plan
This keeps margin near their ask but within precedent.

Nate (Deal Desk): I'll route to CFO and RevRec. Also note we need to set reseller margin payment schedule — monthly versus quarterly. Recommend quarterly reconciliations and a true-up.

Priya (Finance): I'm ok to model with 10% margin + $15k MDF as long as RevRec accepts term structure. Need CRO to ok co-sell credit. Share opp id so I can link to forecast.

Anya (AM): Opp: https://crm.redwood.ai/opps/RED-4599. Need final decision by EOD tomorrow to keep partner engaged.

Ravi (Partner Ops): I'll prep the contract template with co-brand clauses limited to joint marketing and include MDF usage reporting.

Nate (Deal Desk): Routing note: approvals required - Finance, RevRec, Legal, CRO. Setting priority high.

Priya (Finance): If approved, we'll require reporting metrics and a cap on cumulative MDF to ARR ratio. Will draft the finance checklist.

Anya (AM): Thanks team — will update partner with proposed compromise and hold conditional on signatures.

legal-bot: Request received. Please attach draft contract. Expected review 48h.
